statement.estimate_U_needs: Estimate U: |z_γ| ≤ C0 * r^{n_nr(γ)} for polymers γ in the N11 class. Equivalently a block-norm form ||B||_H ≤ r on non-resonant sites (C_gap=1). For a FIXED finite geometric seed, the polymer weight is the activity z = (ψ̃ B Φ)/(ψ̃ Φ). Bounding max|z| on that list gives the C0 piece for THAT CLASS only; it does NOT give ||B||_H for arbitrary words.
statement.what_we_compute: |ψ̃ B Φ/(ψ̃ Φ)| with B = product of A(d_t)/s along the coded window
statement.suffices_for_EU: Sufficient as C0 on the typed singles list IF (Phi,psi,s) are true eigen data and core window = true window (singles: yes). NOT sufficient as ||B||_H, NOT for shorts/uncoded, NOT for arbitrary non-res words.
